description: This is an Android activity class named ScanActivity that manages camera preview, image capture, image processing (edge detection, enhancement, OCR), and saving documents. It utilizes CameraX API and custom processing classes to facilitate document scanning functionality within the app.

classes.name: ScanActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class that provides camera preview, capture, image processing (edge detection, enhancement, OCR), and document saving functionalities for a document scanner app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up camera and user interface controls when the activity is created.

methods.name: setupCamera
methods.description: Initializes and binds the camera with CameraX API.

methods.name: setupActions
methods.description: Sets up button click listeners for capture, close, save, OCR, and enhancement actions.

methods.name: captureImage
methods.description: Captures an image from the camera, applies rotation adjustments, performs edge detection crop, enhancement, and updates the UI with the processed image.
